validity_findings: The corrected GATE-C3 predicate (pairwise_disjoint_on_name_value_after_filter as the sole disjointness check) passes on all 8 anchors (4 positive, 4 negative). The pre-freeze satisfiability dry-run (spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run) correctly demonstrated satisfiability and non-vacuousness with 10 synthetic test cases, including the critical T1/T7 cases where the parent's AND-predicate failed but the corrected predicate passes. This resolves the second consecutive control-plane defect.

Both extraction paths (P-EXTRACT-A html.parser, P-EXTRACT-B independent regex/lexer) show perfect agreement: M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VALUESET=4/4 anchors, M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VERDICT=4/4 anchors, M-EXTRACT-KAPPA=null (not computed but per-field value sets are identical per anchor_metrics.json). NC-PATH-INDEPENDENCE passes with AST attestation (path_b imports only stdlib __future__ and re; no forbidden imports; no anchor host tokens in source; perturbation invariant).

Positive control PC-EXTRACT-CANARY passes: both paths recover 16 distinct non-empty authenticity_token values on CAL-POS-1 across 4 sessions (M-DISTINCT-VALUES-A-CAL-POS-1=16, M-DISTINCT-VALUES-B-CAL-POS-1=16). Negative control NC-CAL-NEG-ALL-REJECTED passes: 0 in-list values on all 4 negative anchors under both paths.

Certificate metrics: M-CERT-ROUTE-OK=4/4, M-CERT-BODY-VARIABLE=4/4, M-CERT-FIELD-PRESENT=3/4 (CAL-POS-4 has no in-list fields), M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-A=0, M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-B=0, M-CERT-FIRST-REQUEST-COOKIELESS=true, M-CERT-PAIRWISE-DISJOINT-AFTER-FILTER=true. All GATE-C and GATE-E gates pass.

Session isolation diagnostic: M-CERT-SESSION-IDENTIFYING-DISJOINT=false (expected; session cookie names like _gitlab_session, WMF-Uniq, authSession, enwikiSession are shared across sessions with distinct values). This is correctly a non-gating diagnostic. M-CERT-UNEXPECTED-SHARED-NAMES shows these shared names outside the allowlist, confirming the name-level predicate would have failed (the parent's defect).

Part II (GATE-B) correctly resolves to DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE per the mandate's new non-degeneracy clause (NC-D1V-ANCHOR-NONDEGENERACY). M-N-D1V=6 trials but M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=1 (only CAL-POS-2). Per-anchor diagnostics confirm: CAL-POS-1 blocked by BODY_DERIVED_ETAG (ETag == sha256(body)[:32] on all sessions, M-TRANSPORT-BODY-DERIVATION-CAL-POS-1=true), CAL-POS-3 blocked by TOKEN_BEARING_FINAL_URL (centralauthLoginToken in final_url), CAL-POS-4 is NO_FIELD. This matches the DESIGN-derived expectation exactly.

Timescale diagnostic (CC-H): CAL-POS-1, CAL-POS-2, CAL-POS-3 are PER_REQUEST_SCALE (M-WARMJAR-VARIATION-RATE=1.0, M-WARMJAR-FRESH-VALUE-VARIATION-RATE=1.0, difference=0.0 within 0.10 threshold). CAL-POS-4 is NO_ROTATION. This bounds any value-binding freshness verdict to per-request applicability, not session-scoped durability.

Raw evidence retention (V10): 40 body files retained with sha256 hashes (16 fresh + 8 warm + 16 negative), records.jsonl with per-record metadata, all artifacts hashed in result.json.artifacts. Frozen input re-verification (V11) passes before and after execution.
Instrument fixtures all pass: SYN-CANARY-BOTH, SYN-EMPTY-VALUE, SYN-JSSTRING, SYN-GUARD-D1V, SYN-GUARD-FRESH, SYN-GUARD-POSTCOND. Guard logic verified on synthetic patterns.

claim_ceiling: EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED is supported on the 4 pinned credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors (CAL-POS-1/2/3/4) with K=4 fresh sessions, stdlib HTTP, one capture date, one egress path (CC-A). C-FRESHNESS may advance at most to EXPERIMENTAL via DIRECTOR (CC-B). The timescale is PER_REQUEST_SCALE on 3/4 anchors (CC-H), bounding any value-binding verdict to short-lived applicability. Part II (blindness/necessity of value-aware channel) is DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE: the D1V population spans only 1 anchor (CAL-POS-2), making the anchor-clustered bootstrap degenerate by construction. This is a pre-declared power statement, not a blindness result. No prevalence over 'the Web' is measured or implied.
